label: Shift and rotate semantics
subgoals: Move every bit by the shift amount
Fill the vacated positions with zeros or with the bits that fell off
Read the result as an unsigned integer

label: A logarithmic shifter
subgoals: Decompose the shift amount into powers of two
Allocate one row of n muxes per bit of the shift amount
Multiply n by the number of stages

label: Which stages act
subgoals: Write the shift amount in binary
Count the stages whose select bit is one
Order stages by the arrival of their select bits
